description: An AI-native creative suite providing CLI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) support for image, video, and character generation inside AI agents.
auth_notes: Users authenticate via browser sign-in using the CLI command 'higgsfield auth login' or through their Higgsfield account via MCP configuration.
credential_notes: Developers can install the CLI and connect via free self-serve browser authentication using their standard Higgsfield user account.
api_notes: Exposes an MCP server and CLI to access image/video generation models, character training, and generation history asynchronously.
mcp_notes: Official Higgsfield MCP server available via '@higgsfield/cli' and companion skills for Claude Code, ChatGPT, OpenClaw, and Hermes Agent.
rationale: Higgsfield provides an official MCP server and CLI with self-serve free authentication, making it fully ready to integrate into agent toolkits today.

evidence.note: Describes authentication via browser sign-in using `higgsfield auth login` and account linking for MCP.
Confirms no API key is required; users authenticate through their Higgsfield account for free self-serve use.
Details the official Higgsfield Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and CLI package `@higgsfield/cli`.
